formulas.ascii: sunHours = sum over table rows of V * duration; insolation = sum of DNI * V * max(cosIncidence, 0) * duration (+ diffuse * svf * duration while altitude > 0), in Wh/m^2; rows with altitude + radius <= 0 are skipped; V = solar-disk visibility over the horizon at the row azimuth; cosIncidence = sin(altitude) without slope and aspect or on flat ground, else cos(slope) sin(altitude) + sin(slope) cos(altitude) cos(azimuth - aspect); NaN where the horizon is NaN
